s01.prompt: Hand-painted gouache illustration with soft visible brush strokes and warm paper grain. The painting fills the whole frame from edge to edge. Muted earth palette with amber and teal accents. Gentle rim light, simple shapes, picture-book composition with the subject in the centre of the frame. No writing or lettering anywhere in the picture: number plates, shop signs and screens are plain blank shapes. Midday in a small town in the Ethiopian highlands. One young man seen from behind, in the centre, a simple backpack on his shoulders, stands facing an old boxy country bus with its door open and bundles tied on its roof rack. Low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs and mud-plastered walls, tall thin eucalyptus trees, red-brown dusty ground, high bright sun, short shadows. Nobody else in the foreground. A slim Ethiopian young man of about nineteen with dark brown skin and short black curly hair, wearing a plain dark jacket over a light shirt, plain trousers and moulded plastic sandals with a closed toe and a buckle strap, carrying one simple backpack.

s09.prompt: Hand-painted gouache illustration with soft visible brush strokes and warm paper grain. The painting fills the whole frame from edge to edge. No writing or lettering anywhere in the picture: number plates, shop signs and screens are plain blank shapes. Golden hour. One man alone, seen from behind, stands at the railing of a balcony and looks out over the wide city of Addis Ababa: low tin-roofed houses mixed with mid-rise concrete and glass buildings, and eucalyptus-covered hills on the horizon. A simple backpack rests on the floor beside his feet and nothing is on his back. Calm warm light. The same man seven years later, in his mid twenties, with dark brown skin and short black curly hair, calm, wearing a plain shirt, always seen from behind.
